final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code AS z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), total AS (SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS n FROM city_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.city, c.attendance_count, CAST(c.attendance_count AS REAL) / t.n AS share FROM city_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.n IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.attendance_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - m.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m WHERE m.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > m.value
